title: Social media advertising: Ads, cost & strategies | Adobe Express

facts.fact: Nearly 5.2 billion people now use social media around the world, according to a DemandSage figure cited by Adobe Express.
facts.quote: nearly [5.2 billion people now use social media](https://www.demandsage.com/social-media-users/) around the world

facts.fact: According to a Forbes Agency Council article cited by Adobe Express, 80% of people make purchasing decisions based on social media posts.
facts.quote: [80% of people](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesagencycouncil/2022/04/28/how-social-media-impacts-consumer-buying/?sh=28689e53337d) make purchasing decisions based on social media posts

facts.fact: Short video ads under one minute in duration are generally more impactful, according to Adobe Express.
facts.quote: Short videos that are less than one minute in duration are generally more impactful.

facts.fact: There are at least 1.7 billion people who use Instagram, according to DataReportal as cited by Adobe Express.
facts.quote: There are at least [1.7 billion people](https://datareportal.com/essential-instagram-stats) who use Instagram

facts.fact: Instagram users are reported as 48% female and 52% male, with data for other genders unavailable.
facts.quote: Users are 48% female and 52% male (data for other genders isn’t available).

facts.fact: The largest age group active on Instagram is 25 to 34 years old, followed by 18 to 24 years old.
facts.quote: The largest age group active on Instagram is 25 to 34 years old, followed by 18 to 24 years old.

facts.fact: Adobe Express states that Instagram reaches over 20% of the world's population.
facts.quote: meaning you have the potential to reach over 20% of the world’s population through Instagram alone.

facts.fact: Facebook has over 3.03 billion active users, according to a Statista statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: With over [3.03 billion active users](https://www.statista.com/statistics/264810/number-of-monthly-active-facebook-users-worldwide/)

facts.fact: The most prevalent age group on Facebook is users 25 to 34 years old.
facts.quote: The most prevalent age group on Facebook is users 25 to 34 years old.

facts.fact: Facebook's user base is 43% female and 57% male.
facts.quote: Users are 43% female and 57% male.

facts.fact: LinkedIn has 1.15 billion users, per a DemandSage statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: LinkedIn has [1.15 billion users.](https://www.demandsage.com/linkedin-statistics/)

facts.fact: The largest age group active on LinkedIn is 25 to 34 years old.
facts.quote: The largest age group active on LinkedIn is 25 to 34 years old.

facts.fact: LinkedIn's user base reports being 48% female and 52% male.
facts.quote: They report being 48% female and 52% male.

facts.fact: YouTube has over 2.5 billion monthly active users, per a DemandSage statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: YouTube has over [2.5 billion monthly active users](https://www.demandsage.com/youtube-stats)

facts.fact: 52% of internet users access YouTube at least once a month.
facts.quote: Additionally, 52% of internet users access YouTube at least once a month

facts.fact: The age group with the highest reach on YouTube is 15 to 35 years old.
facts.quote: The age group with the highest reach on YouTube is 15 to 35 years old.

facts.fact: YouTube's audience is 46% female and 54% male.
facts.quote: They’re 46% female and 54% male.

facts.fact: X (Twitter) has around 611 million monthly active users, per a DemandSage statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: X (Twitter) has around [611 million monthly active users](https://www.demandsage.com/twitter-statistics/)

facts.fact: The largest age group active on Twitter is 18 to 29 years old, with 38.4% female and 61.6% male users.
facts.quote: The largest age group active on Twitter is 18 to 29 years old, with 38.4% being female versus 61.6% male.

facts.fact: Per Twitter's own business page, Twitter users spend 26% more time viewing ads than users of other leading platforms.
facts.quote: spend [26% more time viewing ads](https://business.twitter.com/) than compared to other leading platforms.

facts.fact: TikTok has 1.6 billion active monthly users, per a DemandSage statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: TikTok has [1.6 billion active monthly users](https://www.demandsage.com/tiktok-user-statistics/)

facts.fact: TikTok users are 61% female and 39% male.
facts.quote: TikTok users are 61% female and 39% male.

facts.fact: Snapchat has 443 million daily active users, per a DemandSage statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: Snapchat has [443 million daily active users](https://www.demandsage.com/snapchat-users/)

facts.fact: Snapchat is the fifth most downloaded social media app in the world.
facts.quote: is the fifth most downloaded social media app in the world.

facts.fact: Snapchat's audience is 51% female and 48% male.
facts.quote: They’re 51% female and 48% male.

facts.fact: 553 million people use Pinterest every month, per Pinterest's own audience page.
facts.quote: [553 million people](https://business.pinterest.com/audience/) use Pinterest every month.

facts.fact: Pinterest's audience is 76.2% female and 17.2% male, with the remaining percentage points unspecified.
facts.quote: They’re 76.2% female and 17.2% male (the remaining percentage points are unspecified).

facts.fact: The page states that a social media ad campaign can cost anywhere from a few dollars to thousands, depending on budget and level of investment.
facts.quote: A social media ad campaign can cost anywhere from a few dollars to thousands.

facts.fact: On average, Instagram ads range from $0.20 to $2 per click, according to AdRoll's cited figures for 2021.
facts.quote: On average, Instagram ads range from [$0.20 to $2 per click](https://www.adroll.com/blog/ad-cost-breakdown-facebook-instagram-tiktok-and-pinterest#:~:text=In%202021%2C%20Instagram%20ads%20cost,engagement%20rates%2C%20check%20out%20Instagram).

facts.fact: A Facebook campaign focused on getting impressions costs $0.50-$3.50 per click, while one focused on conversions costs $0.87 per click, per AdEspresso.
facts.quote: A campaign focused on getting impressions [costs $0.50-$3.50 per click, while one focused on conversions costs $0.87 per click](https://adespresso.com/blog/facebook-ads-cost/).

facts.fact: X (Twitter) ads cost $0.26 to $1.50 per action (e.g., click or like), per AdEspresso.
facts.quote: In general, [X ads cost $0.26 to $1.50 per action](https://adespresso.com/blog/twitter-advertising-a-complete-guide/) (e.g., click or like).

facts.fact: TikTok uses an auction-like bidding model with daily campaign budgets set at $50, per LeadsBridge.
facts.quote: [TikTok uses an auction-like bidding model, with daily campaign budgets set at $50](https://leadsbridge.com/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-advertise-on-tiktok/#:~:text=is%20about%20%2450.-,How%20much%20are%20TikTok%20ads%20per%20day%3F,at%20the%20ad%20group%20level).

facts.fact: Snapchat has a minimum ad buy of $5.
facts.quote: There’s a minimum ad buy of $5.

facts.fact: Pinterest ads cost between $2.00 and $5.00 per 1,000 impressions and $0.10 to $1.50 per click, per AdRoll.
facts.quote: You’ll pay somewhere between [$2.00 and $5.00 for every 1,000 Pinterest impressions, and $0.10 to $1.50 per click](https://www.adroll.com/blog/ad-cost-breakdown-facebook-instagram-tiktok-and-pinterest).

facts.fact: In a CMO Survey, B2B companies selling products anticipated spending 14.7% of their marketing budgets on social media in 12 months.
facts.quote: **Business-to-business (B2B) companies selling products** anticipated spending 14.7% of their marketing budgets on social media.

facts.fact: In a CMO Survey, B2B companies selling services planned to spend 18.3% of their marketing budgets on social media in 12 months.
facts.quote: **B2B companies selling services** planned to spend 18.3% of their marketing budgets on social media.

facts.fact: In a CMO Survey, B2C companies selling products anticipated spending 21.8% of their marketing budgets on social media.
facts.quote: **Business-to-consumer (B2C) companies selling products** anticipated spending 21.8%.

facts.fact: In a CMO Survey, B2C companies selling services anticipated spending 18.7% of their marketing budgets on social media.
facts.quote: **B2C companies selling services** anticipated spending 18.7%.

facts.fact: Meta Ads Manager (formerly Facebook Ads Manager) can be used as a centralized point to run ads across Instagram and Facebook.
facts.quote: Use the Meta Ads Manager (formally the Facebook Ads Manager) as a centralized point to run ads across Instagram and Facebook.

facts.fact: The page defines CPA as cost per acquisition, a metric it recommends tracking to gauge social media ad success.
facts.quote: Track conversion rates, click-through rates (CTR), and cost per acquisition (CPA) to gauge success.
